text:
ashley.g: Heads-up — we put the reserved-capacity rollout on hold for cust-cluster-12. Canary p95 jumped ~3x after merge rfc/kernel-hint-317. SLA risk, customers seeing timeouts.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout for reserved-capacity/rc-2026-03-17 started at 1977776950 (auto).

matt_dev: ack. Any obvious correlating changes? kernel-hinting + batching tweaks landed together last week, right?

sanjay: I ran a quick bisect locally. Reproduces on the commit that switched default kernel hinting to "auto-favor-ls" (commit f3b2a9). Logs show the path choosing the slower attentive-kernel for medium-long sequences.

elaine: repro steps? can we get a flamegraph or perf profile from the canary VMs?

sanjay: repro: run loadgen --model redwood-opti-1 --seq 1024 --pattern mixed --batch 8 --kernel-hint=auto. Perf diff attached in thread (flamegraph link): https://perf.redwood/captures/1977777/fg.html

jordan: I see heavy memcpy and slower GEMM path in the flamegraph — kernel fallback path is doing unquantized matmul for those codepaths. That aligns with the kernel selection logs: "selected kernel=attentive_v2 (fallback), reason=hint_mismatch"

kai: CI perf suite also failed for dedicated-reserved tests yesterday but was marked flaky. We should stop ignoring that failure. CI job: ci/perf/dedicated/longseq_p95. Failure output: 
```
p95 baseline: 48ms
p95 current: 152ms
regression: +104ms (x3.1)
```

ashley.g: Exactly — this is why canary flagged it. We need a quick mitigation for the rollout: either force kernel override to previous kernel selection policy or revert the hinting change. Which is faster?

matt_dev: Fastest hotfix: force kernel selection table to prefer legacy-optimized kernel for sequences >=512 until we patch the heuristics. I can ship a knob in serving config and rollout a hotpatch to canaries.

elaine: +1 for knob. Revert PR will take longer (tests, approvals). Also need release notes for Dedicated customers and notify Sales.

jordan: I'll prepare the config patch. Proposed change: 
```
serving.runtime.kernel_overrides = [
  {"min_seq":512, "kernel":"legacy_opt_v1", "priority":100}
]
```

ashley.g: Good. @matt_dev deploy the hotpatch to canary cluster and then gradually to reserved pools if metrics look sane. Create rollback playbook just in case.

matt_dev: deploying hotpatch to canary now. Command: `rbctl apply --cluster cust-cluster-12 --patch kernel-override-1977777`

deploy-bot: Hotpatch submitted to canary at 1977777120. Observability pipelines alerted: p95 dropping, but need 10m window to confirm.

oncall-bot: Incident note: INC-2026-03-17-kerndiff created, severity=high (potential SLA impact). Pager duty notified.

sanjay: After override, local test shows p95 back to baseline (~50ms). Need to follow-up with full perf regression bisect to fix underlying heuristic (batching+hint interaction).

ashley.g: Thanks. Next steps: 1) Hold broader rollout until bisect root cause. 2) Matt to promote hotpatch if canary stable. 3) Sanjay + Jordan to bisect and propose permanent fix (likely batching heuristic + kernel selector compatibility). 4) Elaine to notify Sales + Customer Success with ETA.

elaine: I'll draft customer comms and send to salesops.

matt_dev: Canary looks stable at +15m — promoting to reserved pools is on my queue, will wait for green from oncall in 10m.

oncall-bot: oncall rotation: @sanjay on duty for next 2 hours.

jordan: I'll start the bisect tonight and post candidate commits. If anyone has suspected commits besides f3b2a9, drop them here.

ashley.g: Perfect. Keep updates short in this thread. If we need an incident bridge I'll open one. :thumbsup:
